PhD programmes: calls for applications and ranking lists
The University of Padua offers a wide range of PhD Courses covering all scientific and disciplinary areas: mathematical sciences, physical sciences, information and communication sciences, engineering, earth sciences, life sciences, humanities and social sciences.
To access the PhD, it is necessary to meet specific requirements and pass a public selection process.
